name: Matmut
note: French insurance group. Per Akkodis ASP Team's presentation page, Matmut has been 'present alongside the team since 2019' and continues its support within the team in 2026 in the FFSA GT4 French Championship programme; its logo also stands as a featured partner on the team's site. Who owns or controls Matmut hasn't been traced on the pages checked (its own partner-clubs page lists other clubs, not this team), so it stays unrated.
